PRISONERS(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An

Prisoners
Act, 1900
[Gazette
of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
3rd October, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV, dated
3‑10‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 29th September, 2001 is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(I) This Ordinance may be called
the Prisoners (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 10 of Act III of 1900

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXI OF 2001
PRISONERS(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An

Prisoners
Act, 1900
[Gazette
of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
3rd October, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV, dated
3‑10‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 29th September, 2001 is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment of section 10 of Act III of 1900.‑‑In the Balochistan Prisoners
Act, 1900, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 10 for the words
"Presidency Magistrate" the words "Magistrate" shall be
substituted.
